your line, preventing problems before they start.

# Materials that Adapt™.

# global provider of Halogen-free flame retardants, AND MUCH MORE.

of international trade - pulling together both supplier and customer to work on large-scale
initiatives with the ability to transform an entire industry for the better - whether it be from an
economic, environmental, or social perspective.

 

Since 1976, Century Multech has been a quality chemical supplier & distributor of raw materials to 
diverse industries, including plastics, resins, wood, paper, electronics, automotives, and
construction. We pride ourselves in providing you with the highest quality products at competitive
price and service.  Our customers are located all across North America, Europe, Asia, and South
America. 

 

We supply chemicals that can serve many purposes, including [flame retardants][9], lubricants, and
solvents for carbon dioxide gas treatment.  And we are always on the look out for the latest news in
product development, which could reshape the USA and international chemical communities.

 

The large majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and either melamine or
phosphorus-based. Currently, we are a leading provider of [melamine cyanurate][10]﻿ (flame retardant
additive used primarily for nylon 6, and nylon 66) - available in granular, powder, or customized
form. 

 

Additional notable flame retardants and chemical additives that we can provide you, include
[melamine polyphosphate][11] (MPP) and [melamine phosphate][12] (MP) both applicable for nylon and
coatings, [ammonium polyphosphate][13] in various forms (water-soluble, melamine-treated,
epoxy-treated, etc.), and [melamine][14] crystals (for formaldehyde resins, laminates,
particleboards, coatings, etc.), and much more.

 

If you need more information, please [contact us][15] or call 718-353-9885.

## Guide to avoiding misconceptions| Decision’s recommendation of professional s...

Surfactants are a complex system, though they could be all called surfactants, their specific use
and application might be completely different. For instance, during the tanning process, surfactants
could be used as penetrating agent, leveling agent, wetting back, degreasing, fatliquoring,
retanning, emulsifying or bleaching products.

However, when two surfactants have the same or similar effects, there might be some confusion.

Soaking agent and degreasing agent are the two kinds of surfactant products that are often used
during soaking process. Due to the certain degree of washing and wetting ability of surfactants,
some factories would use it as washing and soaking products. However, the use of specialized ionic
soaking agent is in fact essential and irreplaceable.

## ATO Supply Is
## Constrained.

China’s antimony export restrictions, mine curtailments, and U.S. trade policy have sent ATO spot
pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month lead times industry-wide.

Flamisol supplies three zinc-based synergists specifically qualified for ATO reduction and
replacement in halogenated PVC, polyolefin, and engineering plastic compounds.

[View Zinc Alternatives][48] [Read Market Brief][49]

China's export controls on antimony, classified as a strategic material in 2024, combined with mine
curtailments and U.S. trade policy have pushed ATO spot pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month
lead times across major distributors. IARC Group 2B classification for Sb₂O₃ is simultaneously
triggering specification reviews in automotive, wire and cable, and electronics applications,
compressing the timeline for compounders who have been deferring alternative qualification.

The practical question for procurement is not whether to evaluate alternatives; it is which
zinc-based synergist is the right fit for a given substrate and fire standard. FL-ZS, FL-ZHS, and
FL-ZB each have distinct mechanisms, smoke suppression profiles, and substrate compatibilities. The
comparison table on the [Zinc Synergists page][50] covers all three side by side with ATO.

## ATO Supply Is
## Constrained.

China’s antimony export restrictions, mine curtailments, and U.S. trade policy have sent ATO spot
pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month lead times industry-wide.

Flamisol supplies three zinc-based synergists specifically qualified for ATO reduction and
replacement in halogenated PVC, polyolefin, and engineering plastic compounds.

[View Zinc Alternatives][48] [Read Market Brief][49]

China's export controls on antimony, classified as a strategic material in 2024, combined with mine
curtailments and U.S. trade policy have pushed ATO spot pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month
lead times across major distributors. IARC Group 2B classification for Sb₂O₃ is simultaneously
triggering specification reviews in automotive, wire and cable, and electronics applications,
compressing the timeline for compounders who have been deferring alternative qualification.

The practical question for procurement is not whether to evaluate alternatives; it is which
zinc-based synergist is the right fit for a given substrate and fire standard. FL-ZS, FL-ZHS, and
FL-ZB each have distinct mechanisms, smoke suppression profiles, and substrate compatibilities. The
comparison table on the [Zinc Synergists page][50] covers all three side by side with ATO.

## Improve the resilience and safety of your materials with next-generation GERPHOS flame retardants

### Powerful, yet halogen-free

Future-proof, high-performance flame retardancy without the use of halogens

### Free from antimony trioxide

Ideal for all safety-concerning applications that regulate the use of antimony trioxide

### Toxic-free and Zero VOCs

Harmless and toxic-free: with no VOCs, GERPHOS is the perfect choice for use in public transport

### Easy to apply in various resins

Blends easily with various polymers, including PVC, polyurethane, and acrylates

### Optimizing production costs

Engineered for each individual material matrix using minimum functional solution

### Faster R&D with rapid testing

Product developers benefit from quick and easy small specimen fire-standard testing

### Color fastness with low pigment dose

Excellent color performance with a lower pigment dosage needed than in conventional flame retardants

# Safer World.
# Cleaner Future.

Why take additives at face value

Imagine an eco-friendly flame retardant that delivers the performance you’re looking for – enabling
flame retardancy without compromising on your mechanical performance by its polymeric nature with a
favourable toxic profile.

Now imagine if that same polyphosphonate-based additive is PFAS-free, halogen-free, is non-migrating
and could bring all kinds of added benefits to your products – from transparency to high-thermal
resistance to high tenacity and more..?

## Nofia®: forever safe

We’re Nofia® Solutions. As the original developers of polyphosphonate technology, we help our
customers achieve all these benefits and more with our Nofia® family of polymeric additives.
Designed for tomorrow’s regulations, without compromise. Developed for the manufacturers and brands
whose promises matter, and refuse to choose between safety, performance, and our future health and
environment.

From high-performance plastics to recycled PET fibers, from circuit boards to automotive components,
Nofia’s polymeric technology is redefining what flame retardants can achieve. By delivering
non-leaching, permanent fire safety, Nofia enables industries to design for durability,
recyclability, and tomorrow’s strictest standards — without compromise.

## Our products

Advancing the benchmark with halogen-free, high-performance flame retardants

At Nofia Solutions, we design innovative, eco-friendly, and permanent flame-retardant solutions
trusted by our global customers for their unmatched balance of safety, sustainability, and
performance. Our Nofia® products are non-toxic, non-leaching, and deliver superior fire protection
across industries — from textiles and electronics to construction and transportation

[More information][28]

### Homopolymers

Our Nofia® homopolymers have an exceptionally high limiting oxygen index of 65%, which makes it
particularly well suited to be used as FR additives. Nofia homopolymers are transparent, high
flowing polymers with a glass transition temperature of about 90-105°C. The different grades have
different molecular weights making them suitable for a wide array of applications. From textile
fibers to electrical cables to BOPET and rPET.

### Copolymers

Nofia® copolymers are polyphosphonate-co-carbonates. A range of compositions which can be produced
from high to low phosphonate content. The copolymers have good impact resistance and glass
transition temperatures while maintaining high melt flow and a high limiting oxygen index. They are
typically used in, however not limited to, polycarbonate or PC blends based materials

### Oligomers

Our oligomers are low molecular weight, reactive flame retardant additives. They’re phosphorus based
additives with phenolic end groups suitable for flame retarding thermoset resins, such as
unsaturated polyesters, epoxy, polyurethane and polyurea. They are transparent and highly soluble in
the typical solvents used in thermoset resin processing. Additionally our oligomers are dispersed
prior for us in textile or protective coatings. 

## Our markets

We offer halogen-free flame retardants engineered for key sectors, like: **Building & Construction,
Electrical & Electronics, Fibers & Textiles, and Transportation**. These advanced PFAS-free polymers
enhance fire safety while ensuring thermal stability, mechanical durability, lightweight design,
recyclability, and sustainability — supporting green building, electronics reliability, textile
performance, and fuel-efficient transit solutions.

[More about our markets][29]
[Nofia Solutions]

## About us

As a global leader in sustainable flame-retardant technologies and with a state-of-the-art
manufacturing facility in Belgium, we produce Nofia®, our innovative non-toxic, non-leaching flame
retardant,  designed to enhance fire safety across industries.


Discover how and why Nofia Solutions – built on FRX Polymers - is a pioneer in the polyphosphonate
technology and a partner in your solutions. 

[More about us][30]

  manufacturing, and home appliance industries. However, nylon is a flammable polymer, and its

  insufficient flame retardancy limits its application, particularly in the electrical and

chemicals, offering tailored solutions including fire-resistant flame retardant additives for
polymers. Our engineered masterbatches enhance material properties with anti-static protection, UV

This section separates the two main buying paths: buyers who need flame retardant additives for
compounding, and buyers who need flame retardant masterbatch for easier direct dosing.

**Buyer clarity:** additive or masterbatch **Product scope:** powder, liquid and pellet options
**Selection value:** form, dosing and handling comparison
Line A — Additives

### Flame Retardant Additives

Powders, liquids and compounded polymer additives blended into plastics to reduce flammability.
Halogen-free and halogenated grades for plastic modification, extrusion, injection molding and cable
compound applications.

[White powder flame retardant additive, sieve analysis bench]**Fig. 02** — white powder FR additive,
sieve analysis bench**Proof point: additive form, particle control and QC handling before
formulation.**
* FormsPowder · liquid · compounded blends
* ChemistriesPhosphorus, nitrogen, mineral, brominated + synergists
* Best forIn-house compounding, maximum formulation control
[Explore flame retardant additives →][46] Line B — Masterbatch

### Flame Retardant Masterbatch

Pre-dispersed concentrates of flame retardant additives in a carrier resin. As a flame retardant
masterbatch manufacturer, we customize carrier resin, loading ratio and dispersion performance for
PP, PE, PVC and engineering plastics.

[FR masterbatch pellets exiting an underwater pelletizer]**Fig. 03** — FR masterbatch pellets
exiting underwater pelletizer**Proof point: pelletized masterbatch production, pre-dispersion and
scalable compounding capability.**
* CarriersPP · PE · EVA · PA · custom on request
* Loading40 – 70 % active content, application-dependent
* Best forDirect dosing on extrusion and injection molding lines

# The Industrial Containment & Corrosion Experts

Supplying specialised VCI anti-rust systems and professional shrink wrap containment services to
protect high-value machinery from weather, transit damage, and corrosion across the nation.
[Speak to Us][43]

## SHRINK WRAP PACKAGING PRODUCTS

We supply a full range of industrial-grade shrink film, heat tools, and accessories.

[VIEW PRODUCTS][44]

## CONTAINMENT

Leading provider of innovative on-site containment solutions for environmental exclusion, hazard
control, and project-specific needs. We specialise in custom, heavy-duty shrink wrap containment for
large machinery and infrastructure assets.

[LEARN MORE][45]

## CORROSION & ASSET PRESERVATION

Advanced corrosion prevention solutions tailored to a diverse range of industries. We utilise and
apply VCI technology to deliver clean, long-term, residue-free protection for metal assets in
storage and transit.

[LEARN ABOUT VCI][46]
[Heavy haul shrink wrap containment services for large machinery, marine vessels, and industrial
tanks in Australia]

## Your partner to supply, protect, contain, preserve, and monitor with care.

We specialise in the manufacturing of high-quality shrink films and VCI anti-corrosion products
designed to safeguard your valuable assets.

Our corrosion preservation and industrial containment services ensure your equipment stays in top
condition, even in the most demanding environments. Additionally, we offer cutting-edge IoT
monitoring devices that provide real-time insights to enhance efficiency and reliability.

With a commitment to excellence and innovation, we provide comprehensive solutions that protect,
preserve, and optimize your operations.

[REQUEST A QUOTE][47][Read Our Capability Statement][48]

To ensure the highest level of asset protection and containment, Tufwrap only supply premium-grade
materials trusted by industry leaders. Explore our selection of specialised shrink films, VCI
packaging, and heavy-duty industrial supplies designed for peak performance in any environment.

[[Injection Tray]][28]

## Forming Better Solutions

Automatic packaging processes require custom solutions. We work with our clients to design and
produce plastic products that exceed their needs and fit their automation systems seamlessly.

Read more on our work to become one of [GM's Supplier of the Year][29] winners for 2023.

## Forming Better Lives

When you become part of the Vantage Plastics team, you are joining an innovative organization. Each
of our employees contributes to our culture based on our core company values.

[Award-03488]

### Humbly Confident

Confident in our skills, knowledge, and abilities but ready to engage with, listen to, and learn
from others to discover yet even better ways.

[SVSU Award--6_Web]

### All Actions with Integrity

Act with honesty, ethics, and strong moral principles, creating an environment of trust with those
we serve.

[535133494_1217801000387593_1320972340036001715_n]

### Servant Hearts

Serving one another, our customers, our suppliers, and our community to our world locally and
nationally a better place.

[Vantage Machine]

### Pursue Opportunities That Drive Us Forward

Identifying opportunities that will exist in the near future and acting on those that will align
with our mission.

## Forming Sustainable Futures


At Vantage Plastics, we specialize in sustainable solutions across a wide range of processes,
including thin and thick gauge thermoforming, injection molding, plastic sheet extrusion, and
innovative recycling practices. Our products are designed to save you money while actively reducing
environmental impact. By combining advanced manufacturing techniques with a commitment to
sustainability, we help shape a better future for your business and our planet.

[Honda-6237]

## Let's Get Started!

Transform your vision into durable reality with our superior thermoforming and injection molding
services. We craft customized thermoplastic solutions using thick-gauge thermoforming and precision
injection molding techniques. From sturdy components to complex assemblies, our innovative plastic
manufacturing processes ensure unmatched quality.
Partner with experts who deliver excellence in every product.

# Chemistry that Thinks™.
# Materials that Adapt™.

For nearly 170 years we have mastered the molecular. Today we are mastering the digital. By
integrating AI driven insights with world class manufacturing, Hexion is pioneering a future of
**Chemistry-as-a-Service^{TM}**. A future where we provide chemistry that thinks, materials that
adapt, to make your products and your teams smarter, better, and more efficient.

## At Hexion, we don't just build products, we build legacies.

Our teams and tools span chemical engineering, manufacturing, and material science all under one
roof.

### A foundation built together

Backed by partnerships spanning 50+ years and a top-ten customer roster averaging 25 years of
loyalty, delivering the stability and trust needed to scale with confidence.

### 170 years of Molecular Memory

Combining a century of chemical data with AI-driven insights to predict variables before they hit
your line, preventing problems before they start.

### We win when you win

Engineering custom formulations and actionable data that lower waste, raise margins, and deliver the
“Golden Batch” every single day.

Build a foundation of material intelligence enabling you to adapt your line and your chemicals to
get the most out of them

Optimize your manufacturing setpoints to save costs, enhance throughput, improve quality, and reduce
energy & material use.

### Adaptive Resin Platform

Get resin that is formulated to your specific outcomes by leveraging data and responding to evolving
business priorities and changes in environmental factors.

## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

# global provider of Halogen-free flame retardants, AND MUCH MORE.

Our dream from Day One has been to serve as a leading global connector and facilitator in the field
of international trade - pulling together both supplier and customer to work on large-scale
initiatives with the ability to transform an entire industry for the better - whether it be from an
economic, environmental, or social perspective.

 

Since 1976, Century Multech has been a quality chemical supplier & distributor of raw materials to 
diverse industries, including plastics, resins, wood, paper, electronics, automotives, and
construction. We pride ourselves in providing you with the highest quality products at competitive
price and service.  Our customers are located all across North America, Europe, Asia, and South
America. 

 

We supply chemicals that can serve many purposes, including [flame retardants][9], lubricants, and
solvents for carbon dioxide gas treatment.  And we are always on the look out for the latest news in
product development, which could reshape the USA and international chemical communities.

 

The large majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and either melamine or
phosphorus-based. Currently, we are a leading provider of [melamine cyanurate][10]﻿ (flame retardant
additive used primarily for nylon 6, and nylon 66) - available in granular, powder, or customized
form. 

 

Additional notable flame retardants and chemical additives that we can provide you, include
[melamine polyphosphate][11] (MPP) and [melamine phosphate][12] (MP) both applicable for nylon and
coatings, [ammonium polyphosphate][13] in various forms (water-soluble, melamine-treated,
epoxy-treated, etc.), and [melamine][14] crystals (for formaldehyde resins, laminates,
particleboards, coatings, etc.), and much more.

 

If you need more information, please [contact us][15] or call 718-353-9885.

# global provider of Halogen-free flame retardants, AND MUCH MORE.

Our dream from Day One has been to serve as a leading global connector and facilitator in the field
of international trade - pulling together both supplier and customer to work on large-scale
initiatives with the ability to transform an entire industry for the better - whether it be from an
economic, environmental, or social perspective.

 

Since 1976, Century Multech has been a quality chemical supplier & distributor of raw materials to 
diverse industries, including plastics, resins, wood, paper, electronics, automotives, and
construction. We pride ourselves in providing you with the highest quality products at competitive
price and service.  Our customers are located all across North America, Europe, Asia, and South
America. 

 

We supply chemicals that can serve many purposes, including [flame retardants][9], lubricants, and
solvents for carbon dioxide gas treatment.  And we are always on the look out for the latest news in
product development, which could reshape the USA and international chemical communities.

 

The large majority of our flame retardants are halogen-free, and either melamine or
phosphorus-based. Currently, we are a leading provider of [melamine cyanurate][10]﻿ (flame retardant
additive used primarily for nylon 6, and nylon 66) - available in granular, powder, or customized
form. 

 

Additional notable flame retardants and chemical additives that we can provide you, include
[melamine polyphosphate][11] (MPP) and [melamine phosphate][12] (MP) both applicable for nylon and
coatings, [ammonium polyphosphate][13] in various forms (water-soluble, melamine-treated,
epoxy-treated, etc.), and [melamine][14] crystals (for formaldehyde resins, laminates,
particleboards, coatings, etc.), and much more.

 

If you need more information, please [contact us][15] or call 718-353-9885.

## Guide to avoiding misconceptions| Decision’s recommendation of professional s...

Surfactants are a complex system, though they could be all called surfactants, their specific use
and application might be completely different. For instance, during the tanning process, surfactants
could be used as penetrating agent, leveling agent, wetting back, degreasing, fatliquoring,
retanning, emulsifying or bleaching products.

However, when two surfactants have the same or similar effects, there might be some confusion.

Soaking agent and degreasing agent are the two kinds of surfactant products that are often used
during soaking process. Due to the certain degree of washing and wetting ability of surfactants,
some factories would use it as washing and soaking products. However, the use of specialized ionic
soaking agent is in fact essential and irreplaceable.

## ATO Supply Is
## Constrained.

China’s antimony export restrictions, mine curtailments, and U.S. trade policy have sent ATO spot
pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month lead times industry-wide.

Flamisol supplies three zinc-based synergists specifically qualified for ATO reduction and
replacement in halogenated PVC, polyolefin, and engineering plastic compounds.

[View Zinc Alternatives][48] [Read Market Brief][49]

China's export controls on antimony, classified as a strategic material in 2024, combined with mine
curtailments and U.S. trade policy have pushed ATO spot pricing to multi-year highs with 2.5–3 month
lead times across major distributors. IARC Group 2B classification for Sb₂O₃ is simultaneously
triggering specification reviews in automotive, wire and cable, and electronics applications,
compressing the timeline for compounders who have been deferring alternative qualification.

The practical question for procurement is not whether to evaluate alternatives; it is which
zinc-based synergist is the right fit for a given substrate and fire standard. FL-ZS, FL-ZHS, and
FL-ZB each have distinct mechanisms, smoke suppression profiles, and substrate compatibilities. The
comparison table on the [Zinc Synergists page][50] covers all three side by side with ATO.

#### Apply in ANY resin

#### GERPHOS FLAME RETARDANTS

## Improve the resilience and safety of your materials with next-generation GERPHOS flame retardants

### Powerful, yet halogen-free

Future-proof, high-performance flame retardancy without the use of halogens

### Free from antimony trioxide

Ideal for all safety-concerning applications that regulate the use of antimony trioxide

### Toxic-free and Zero VOCs

Harmless and toxic-free: with no VOCs, GERPHOS is the perfect choice for use in public transport

### Easy to apply in various resins

Blends easily with various polymers, including PVC, polyurethane, and acrylates

### Optimizing production costs

Engineered for each individual material matrix using minimum functional solution

### Faster R&D with rapid testing

Product developers benefit from quick and easy small specimen fire-standard testing

### Color fastness with low pigment dose

Excellent color performance with a lower pigment dosage needed than in conventional flame retardants

# Safer World.
# Cleaner Future.

Why take additives at face value

Imagine an eco-friendly flame retardant that delivers the performance you’re looking for – enabling
flame retardancy without compromising on your mechanical performance by its polymeric nature with a
favourable toxic profile.

Now imagine if that same polyphosphonate-based additive is PFAS-free, halogen-free, is non-migrating
and could bring all kinds of added benefits to your products – from transparency to high-thermal
resistance to high tenacity and more..?

## Nofia®: forever safe

We’re Nofia® Solutions. As the original developers of polyphosphonate technology, we help our
customers achieve all these benefits and more with our Nofia® family of polymeric additives.
Designed for tomorrow’s regulations, without compromise. Developed for the manufacturers and brands
whose promises matter, and refuse to choose between safety, performance, and our future health and
environment.

From high-performance plastics to recycled PET fibers, from circuit boards to automotive components,
Nofia’s polymeric technology is redefining what flame retardants can achieve. By delivering
non-leaching, permanent fire safety, Nofia enables industries to design for durability,
recyclability, and tomorrow’s strictest standards — without compromise.

## Our products

Advancing the benchmark with halogen-free, high-performance flame retardants

At Nofia Solutions, we design innovative, eco-friendly, and permanent flame-retardant solutions
trusted by our global customers for their unmatched balance of safety, sustainability, and
performance. Our Nofia® products are non-toxic, non-leaching, and deliver superior fire protection
across industries — from textiles and electronics to construction and transportation

[More information][28]

### Homopolymers

Our Nofia® homopolymers have an exceptionally high limiting oxygen index of 65%, which makes it
particularly well suited to be used as FR additives. Nofia homopolymers are transparent, high
flowing polymers with a glass transition temperature of about 90-105°C. The different grades have
different molecular weights making them suitable for a wide array of applications. From textile
fibers to electrical cables to BOPET and rPET.

### Copolymers

Nofia® copolymers are polyphosphonate-co-carbonates. A range of compositions which can be produced
from high to low phosphonate content. The copolymers have good impact resistance and glass
transition temperatures while maintaining high melt flow and a high limiting oxygen index. They are
typically used in, however not limited to, polycarbonate or PC blends based materials

### Oligomers

Our oligomers are low molecular weight, reactive flame retardant additives. They’re phosphorus based

### Homopolymers

Our Nofia® homopolymers have an exceptionally high limiting oxygen index of 65%, which makes it
particularly well suited to be used as FR additives. Nofia homopolymers are transparent, high
flowing polymers with a glass transition temperature of about 90-105°C. The different grades have
different molecular weights making them suitable for a wide array of applications. From textile
fibers to electrical cables to BOPET and rPET.

### Copolymers

Nofia® copolymers are polyphosphonate-co-carbonates. A range of compositions which can be produced
from high to low phosphonate content. The copolymers have good impact resistance and glass
transition temperatures while maintaining high melt flow and a high limiting oxygen index. They are
typically used in, however not limited to, polycarbonate or PC blends based materials

## Two Core Product Lines for Flame Retardant Polymer Applications

This section separates the two main buying paths: buyers who need flame retardant additives for
compounding, and buyers who need flame retardant masterbatch for easier direct dosing.

**Buyer clarity:** additive or masterbatch **Product scope:** powder, liquid and pellet options
**Selection value:** form, dosing and handling comparison
Line A — Additives

### Flame Retardant Additives

Powders, liquids and compounded polymer additives blended into plastics to reduce flammability.
Halogen-free and halogenated grades for plastic modification, extrusion, injection molding and cable
compound applications.

[White powder flame retardant additive, sieve analysis bench]**Fig. 02** — white powder FR additive,
sieve analysis bench**Proof point: additive form, particle control and QC handling before
formulation.**
* FormsPowder · liquid · compounded blends
* ChemistriesPhosphorus, nitrogen, mineral, brominated + synergists
* Best forIn-house compounding, maximum formulation control
[Explore flame retardant additives →][46] Line B — Masterbatch

### Flame Retardant Masterbatch

Pre-dispersed concentrates of flame retardant additives in a carrier resin. As a flame retardant
masterbatch manufacturer, we customize carrier resin, loading ratio and dispersion performance for
PP, PE, PVC and engineering plastics.

[FR masterbatch pellets exiting an underwater pelletizer]**Fig. 03** — FR masterbatch pellets
exiting underwater pelletizer**Proof point: pelletized masterbatch production, pre-dispersion and
scalable compounding capability.**
* CarriersPP · PE · EVA · PA · custom on request
* Loading40 – 70 % active content, application-dependent
* Best forDirect dosing on extrusion and injection molding lines

combination with dibromo neopentyl alcohol to make full use of their hydroxyl function.

Supplying specialised VCI anti-rust systems and professional shrink wrap containment services to
protect high-value machinery from weather, transit damage, and corrosion across the nation.

We supply a full range of industrial-grade shrink film, heat tools, and accessories.

control, and project-specific needs. We specialise in custom, heavy-duty shrink wrap containment for
large machinery and infrastructure assets.

condition, even in the most demanding environments. Additionally, we offer cutting-edge IoT
monitoring devices that provide real-time insights to enhance efficiency and reliability.

preserve, and optimize your operations.

Revolutionizing Plastic Manufacturing Processing for Your Thermoforming & Injection Molding Projects

[[Injection Tray]][28]

## Forming Better Solutions

Automatic packaging processes require custom solutions. We work with our clients to design and
produce plastic products that exceed their needs and fit their automation systems seamlessly.

Read more on our work to become one of [GM's Supplier of the Year][29] winners for 2023.

## Forming Better Lives

When you become part of the Vantage Plastics team, you are joining an innovative organization. Each
of our employees contributes to our culture based on our core company values.

[Award-03488]

### Humbly Confident

Confident in our skills, knowledge, and abilities but ready to engage with, listen to, and learn
from others to discover yet even better ways.

[SVSU Award--6_Web]

### All Actions with Integrity

Act with honesty, ethics, and strong moral principles, creating an environment of trust with those
we serve.

[535133494_1217801000387593_1320972340036001715_n]

### Servant Hearts

Serving one another, our customers, our suppliers, and our community to our world locally and
nationally a better place.

[Vantage Machine]

### Pursue Opportunities That Drive Us Forward

Identifying opportunities that will exist in the near future and acting on those that will align
with our mission.

## Forming Sustainable Futures


At Vantage Plastics, we specialize in sustainable solutions across a wide range of processes,
including thin and thick gauge thermoforming, injection molding, plastic sheet extrusion, and
innovative recycling practices. Our products are designed to save you money while actively reducing
environmental impact. By combining advanced manufacturing techniques with a commitment to
sustainability, we help shape a better future for your business and our planet.

[Honda-6237]

## Let's Get Started!

Transform your vision into durable reality with our superior thermoforming and injection molding
services. We craft customized thermoplastic solutions using thick-gauge thermoforming and precision
injection molding techniques. From sturdy components to complex assemblies, our innovative plastic
manufacturing processes ensure unmatched quality.
Partner with experts who deliver excellence in every product.
